meta.notes: A new liquid with its block (msm_starter:mint_water) and its bucket (msm_starter:mint_water_bucket), made from this one element. It behaves like water: it joins the water tag, so players and mobs swim in it, drown in it and are put out when burning. It flows one block every 5 ticks (tick_delay), finds slopes up to 4 blocks away (slope_distance) and loses 1 level with every block it flows (drop_off); a gap between two pools fills up for good (infinite). It is drawn with vanilla's moving water pictures under the tint #3cc88c; give it pictures of its own in textures to change that; the bucket has a picture of its own. Fluids need the Fabric mod jar export.
